'''Jedi Luke Skywalker Jabba's Palace Clouds''' is a [[Dark]] deck by Jedi Luke Skywalker, published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ds14.htm Jabba's Palace Clouds], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010119090000/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ds14.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' Jedi Luke Skywalker
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Special Edition]] (from the card pool)
* '''Published:''' [[Trandosite]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
